company.name: Gopuff
company.shortDescription: Gopuff is a digital delivery service designed to deliver daily essentials within minutes.
company.description:
GoPuff delivers products like over-the-counter medicine, baby food, and alcohol. Across America, GoPuff is known for satiating late-night cravings for Ben and Jerry’s ice cream, Doritos, Red Bull, and, in select markets, White Claw and rescuing those in need of diapers, condoms, and cleaning products. GoPuff allows users the joy of browsing the shelves without the hassle of going to the store. It takes seconds to navigate the app and minutes for Gopuff’s Driver-Partners to deliver the customer’s needs and wants.

The company was founded in 2013 by Yakir Gola and Rafael Ilishayev, two Drexel University students with a minivan and a vision to make everyday life a little easier.

aiResearchSummary.text: Gopuff is researching capacity management for a fleet routing service, as described in a method for receiving and managing multiple capacity values for vehicles. They are also developing systems and methods of simulating fleet services based on historical trip data, including request times, origins, and destinations. Additionally, Gopuff is working on systems and methods of routing on pedestrian pathways, updating maps to include sidewalks. These areas reflect a focus on optimizing delivery logistics and routing.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $250,000,000, or 6.76% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $287,358,827 to $8,500,000,000, a 29.58x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 82 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-20).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
